Pairio (https://pairio.app) | Senior Swift Engineer | REMOTE (Europe) | 32-40h/week | Employee or freelance | $65k-$85k + equity

Pairio is a native macOS app for real-time screen sharing, built for people who work together. You share your screen, your teammate draws on it and takes over your keyboard. One click to call, no link, no invite. We use it every day to build it.

You'd work on pixel-perfect screen sharing (capture, encode, transport, rendering), one-click calling (WebRTC), drawing and remote control, privacy (app masking, encryption) and latency. The Swift app talks to a Rails backend, so bonus points if you're comfortable on both sides.

We're looking for deep native macOS or iOS experience in Swift, a real feel for UX and pixel-perfect UI, and someone who enjoys owning large parts of a product in a small team. Please be based in Europe so we have real overlap for pairing.

We're four founders in Amsterdam running a healthy, profitable business. Stack: Swift, SwiftUI, AppKit, Rails. Flexible start.

Email us a bit about yourself, what you've built and why this interests you: hello@pairio.app, or see https://pairio.app/jobs

Revieve Oy | Senior Product Engineer | REMOTE [Europe / (GMT+2)] | Contract, full-time |

Revieve (Helsinki, with a US office and a team in Asia) builds AI, AR and computer-vision personalization for beauty brands and retailers: skin analysis, virtual try-on and product recommendations. We work with 120+ brands and retailers in 40+ countries, and our product reaches millions of end users.

We're a small team (30+ people, about a dozen engineers) spread across eight time zones, and we've reorganized around the idea that one builder with the right tools can do what a team used to. This role exists because we believe that.

A typical week: a real customer problem lands in front of you with full context, and you decide what to build. Tuesday you sketch it in an AI design tool and prototype in Claude Code. Wednesday it's on staging and you send the founders a Loom. Thursday it's in production. About 1-2 hours of meetings a week, mostly async. No standups, no sprints, no PM or designer in the loop.

What we're looking for:

- Public proof of building: repos, products or side projects we can click around - AI in production, with an opinion about agents, evals, latency and what fails - Fluency with agentic coding (Claude Code, Codex, MCP, custom harnesses) - Design taste: you can take an idea to a working interface without a designer - Generalist instincts: TypeScript/React up front, comfortable with backend integrations and infra - Clear written thinking: READMEs, PRs, post-mortems

Process: intro call, then a paid build session where we work on a real problem together (that's where the hire decision happens, for both sides), a short presentation to the team, then an offer.

Perks: flexible hours, performance-based option plan, equipment budget, five weeks' vacation, paid parental leave.

Details and apply: https://revieve.factorialhr.com/job_posting/senior-product-e... (please mention HN)

Modash.io | Senior Product Engineer | Remote (Europe) | Full-time | €75k–110k | https://modash.io

Modash helps brands find, manage, and pay creators - and helps creators earn a living.

The product looks simple on the surface. Underneath, we index 380M+ public creator profiles across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube so that 1,700+ brands search, evaluate, manage, and pay creators without drowning in spreadsheets and tabs.

We're looking for Senior Product Engineers who like owning ambiguous problems end-to-end. No perfectly shaped tickets. You talk to customers, understand messy workflows, make product decisions, ship, and own whether it actually works.

The problems we care about: - How do you make a 380M-profile dataset feel fast, trustworthy, and easy to explore? - How do you turn chaotic influencer marketing workflows into product that feels obvious? - How do you build tools that work for both small teams and brands like Stanley, Sennheiser, Birkenstock, and NordVPN??

We're 85 people, raised an €11M Series A, and ARR is doubling every year. HQ is in Tallinn, engineering is fully remote across Europe. No ticket factory. No seven layers of approval. Small teams, real ownership, hard product problems.

Engineering blog: https://modash.io/engineering Apply: https://apply.workable.com/modash/j/C1507B65C3

Lokker.com | Data Scientist, Classification and Scoring | REMOTE: North America / Europe, UTC-8 to UTC+2 | Full-time

Lokker is a privacy platform. We continuously analyze websites, applications, third-party technologies and data flows to identify privacy, security and consent risks in production. We have built a large proprietary dataset from years of observing real-world digital behavior, and we are hiring a data scientist to help us expand and improve the classification, scoring and risk intelligence built on it.

You will develop and improve models that classify digital activity, identify meaningful privacy and security behaviors, and assess the confidence and significance of findings.

Looking for 2 to 4 years of production experience in data science and machine learning. Strong Python and SQL, pandas or Polars, scikit-learn and modern classification techniques, familiarity with model evaluation and explainability. Practical experience in training and evaluating supervised classification models on real PRODUCTION data, practical LLM experience beyond simple demonstrations, and curiosity about how websites and internet technologies actually behave. You do not need a privacy or adtech background. We will teach the domain.

You will work closely with engineering, product and privacy experts, and what you build goes directly into the product.

IMPORTANT: the timezone range above is a hard requirement, not a preference. We cannot make an exception.

ON APPLICATIONS: we assume you used AI to help write it. So do we. What we cannot do is verify a claim that exists only in the document you sent us, so make sure the skills you claim are visible somewhere public: LinkedIn with real dates and role detail, GitHub, papers, Kaggle, a writeup, a talk. If your best work is under NDA, say so and describe it in your own words.

A human reads every application. No keyword filter, no automated rejection.

Apply: https://lokker.com/careers/openings/data-scientist-classific...

Founding Engineer (Security / AI / Distributed Systems) — Stealth Project Next-Gen Secure DePIN x Multi-Agent SLM Trading Platform (Stealth / DM for Proposal)

We are building a highly secure, decentralized AI-automated asset management and trading platform running on edge DePIN nodes. The platform utilizes 10 specialized SLMs (Small Language Models) for asynchronous execution. To ensure absolute privacy for institutional and whale traders, we implement a hard-layered defense system. This eliminates the front-running and data-selling risks common in current "free" AI wallets.

At FusionAuth, our mission is to make authentication and authorization simple and secure for every developer building web and mobile applications. We want devs to stop worrying about auth and focus on building something awesome.

There are a lot of companies in the auth space, but we feel like we have something special:

* a relatively unique deployment model (self-host on-prem, run in your cloud or let us operate it for you in ours)

* A well designed API first approach; one customer compared our APIs to petrichor

* a mature product (the code base is nine+ years old and we've found and fixed a lot of the sharp edges around core login use cases; but don't worry, there are plenty more features to add)

* a full featured free-as-in-beer version which makes the sales cycle easier; prospects often come in having prototyped an integration

Our core software is commercial. We open source much of our supporting infrastructure. Technologies and standards that you will work with: modern Java, PostgreSQL, Docker, Kubernetes, MySQL, OAuth, SAML, OIDC.

Learn more, including benefits and salaries, and apply here: https://fusionauth.io/careers/ ( Click/tap the 'View open positions' orange button. )

FusionAuth | Principal Software Engineer, Senior Java Engineers, Account Executive, Customer Support Manager | Varies between REMOTE (in USA, also in Europe but only for the account exec position) and ONSITE in Denver, CO, USA, details in each job desc | Salary ranges for the Principal Software Engineer it is 225k-270k, but the Euro positions don't have them :(

At FusionAuth, our mission is to make authentication and authorization simple and secure for every developer building web and mobile applications. We want devs to stop worrying about auth and focus on building something awesome.

There are a lot of companies in the auth space, but we feel like we have something special:

* a relatively unique deployment model (self-host on-prem, run in your cloud or let us operate it for you in ours)

* A well designed API first approach; one customer compared our APIs to petrichor

* a mature product (the code base is nine+ years old and we've found and fixed a lot of the sharp edges around core login use cases; but don't worry, there are plenty more features to add)

* a full featured free-as-in-beer version which makes the sales cycle easier; prospects often come in having prototyped an integration

Our core software is commercial. We open source much of our supporting infrastructure. Technologies and standards that you will work with: modern Java, PostgreSQL, Docker, Kubernetes, MySQL, OAuth, SAML, OIDC.

Learn more, including benefits and salaries, and apply here: https://fusionauth.io/careers/ ( Click/tap the 'View open positions' orange button. )

Flexibits | Android Software Engineer | Remote | Full-time https://flexibits.com/jobs

We make Fantastical and Cardhop, award-winning calendar and contacts apps for macOS, iOS, visionOS, and Windows. We are a small, fully-remote company spread across the US and Europe, and welcome anyone from around the world. We prefer candidates that are in time zones between US Pacific Time and Central European Time.

We're looking for an enthusiastic and experienced Android developer to help bring the joy of Flexibits apps to Android. This will include learning the ins and outs of Fantastical and bringing its magic to Android, all the way from the natural language parser to the beautiful user interface.

Tech stack: Kotlin, C#, Objective-C, Swift, AppKit, UIKit, SwiftUI, C, C++.

NetBird | Berlin, Germany (or remote, CET/CEST overlap) | Full-time https://netbird.io/careers NetBird is open source networking and access control WireGuard-based overlay networks with zero-config peer-to-peer connectivity. Open source, built in Europe, used by thousands of teams worldwide. We're a small and growing team going up against (and working with) the incumbents in network security. Post Series A.

- Engineering Manager : You will take a huge part in leading and scaling our engineering org. Unblocking, scaling, hiring, you'll still read code and hold technical opinions that impact the product. We're not looking for a pure people manager. Networking/infra background is a plus. If you've scaled a team from 0 to 20+ and seen your product scale too, I'd love to talk to you.

- Senior/Staff Backend Engineer (Go) : the control plane: peer coordination, policy and access control, multi-tenancy, and keeping it all fast as customer networks grow into the hundreds of thousands of peers.

- Network / Client Engineer (Go) — the agent side: WireGuard, NAT traversal and hole punching, relays, DNS, and shipping one client across Linux, macOS, Windows, iOS and Android. If you enjoy debugging why one connection out of a thousand won't go peer-to-peer, this is the role.

- Solutions Engineer — technical, customer-facing, pre/post-sales. You'll be the person who architects a rollout for a 500-person company's network live on a call, and a great channel back into the roadmap.

- Account Executives :)

We have an office in Berlin and mostly work CET/CEST. We'd love to have you in the office with us, but if your experience is stellar we're happy to hire remote. We're scaling quickly, so this is a chance to join early and scale with us.

Apply at https://netbird.io/careers, please mention you found us on Hacker News in your application.

Coder | https://coder.com/ | Multiple roles | Multiple locations | Full-time

Coder is an AI software development company leading the future of autonomous coding. We empower teams to build software faster, more securely, and at scale through the collaboration of AI coding agents and human developers. Our mission is to make agentic AI a safe, trusted, and integral part of every software development lifecycle.

Coder’s self-hosted Agentic Development Environment (ADE) is the foundation for deploying agentic AI in the enterprise. It provides a secure, standardized, and governed workspace to deploy autonomous coding agents alongside human developers, accelerating innovation while maintaining control and compliance. Coder's isolated, policy-driven environments improve productivity, cut cloud costs, and reduce data risks. Developers transition to AI at their own pace using their own tools. Platform and security teams can govern, audit, and manage a great developer experience at scale.

Check out our OSS product with 100k+ stars on GitHub! https://github.com/coder

All positions are fully remote in the countries listed unless otherwise specified.

Vistulo hires engineers in Poland to work on trading systems for capital-markets clients. All roles below are with a top North American bank: actively developed front-office systems (algorithmic order management and routing, FX, fixed income, and one of the largest Calypso deployments in the world). Audio/Video Collaboration company, worldwide | GMT-2 <--> GMT+2 | Remote | Full time or part time or contract

We have a new opening! We're a dynamic truly-global team developing high-end audio and video collaboration tools.

A long-term opportunity exist to be the architect and team lead for a new version of a widely-used multimedia product based on existing proven patterns, but expanded to new platforms and capabilities. You must have a strong background in audio DSP, networked audio and cross-platform architecture. European timezone only.

We bring beautiful, complex systems to life. Our customers LOVE us. We have small teams: you work closely with the product owners and your input and expertise is meaningful and has an impact.

We're a 100% remote company in business for many years supporting the film, media and broadcast industry. Celebrated for our attention to technical detail and for solving hard problems, we're working on vital technology. There's something interesting going on every day and you'd have the opportunity to be part of driving how the industry moves forward in a post-pandemic world. You'll be part of a team of experts working 100% remotely.

You must have a strong background in audio DSP, networked audio and cross-platform architecture.

Please send resume to hello@loopcontrol.io that shows experience in the above-mentioned required areas and you are in timezone GMT-2 <--> GMT+2. We respond to all valid candidates. We strive for diversity and welcome all persons to apply. 4DWW possible. Family friendly / flexi-time.

Descartes - Finale Inventory | Senior Software Engineer | REMOTE | Full-Time

Finale Inventory is a SaaS application that helps ecommerce sellers manage their operations efficiently. We integrate with over 25 other systems (Amazon, eBay, Shopify, QuickBooks, etc.) to give our customers a complete picture of their business.

We’re a remote-first team that has built a thriving business grounded on long term relationships with our customers and employees.

Our culture is focused on delighting our customers, honesty, transparency, learning and innovating with our colleagues and customers, and constant improvement.

You'll be joining a team of 15 engineers spread across North America, South America, and Western Europe. We use continuous deployment practices to ship code to production several times per day and have a strong test driven development approach. Our technology stack is predominantly JavaScript (Node.js, React) with C++ used in select places for performance.

Interested? Contact Jason Forbes, Director of Software Development, jforbes@descartes.com.
